settings: Second run, after the engine and kit changes of 1.0.0-rc.6. Same conditions as the first run: one new session per task, no follow-up messages, unedited answers. Task 10's bug 7 was reworked before this run (open tasks listed first). Manual scores are not filled in yet.

01.notes: Works in every engine; style.css again uses raw colors instead of tokens.

02.notes: All checks pass (setState with a function now works).

03.notes: The user menu and the tabs are adopted with vf.attach (no render) and keep their state in the component; the DOM is updated in onUpdate, which never runs for a component without render, so the menu and tabs do not change.

04.notes: Reads vf.$('[data-ref="done"]')[0], treating vf.$ as returning an array (it returns the first element), so the welcome text is never shown.

06.notes: Calls forEach on vf.$(…), treating it as an array; the page error stops the app before the first page renders.

08.notes: All checks pass (setState with a function now works).

10.notes: All seven bugs fixed with no rule broken.
